Aaron —

Great to meet today — thanks for taking the time to walk through integration needs and your procurement timeline. Per our call, I put together a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the vendor onboarding / procurement milestone so we can get Redwood set up in your system and avoid delays during implementation. Attached: 20261110_MAP_Draft_Acme.xlsx (MAP draft).

Summary (high level):
- Target close (contract & vendor setup): 2026-12-15
- Key milestone: Procurement/vendor onboarding completed (Ariba/Coupa profile + W-9 + banking details)

Proposed MAP milestones (owner / target):
1) Procurement intake & vendor form submitted — Acme procurement — 2026-11-12 (dependency: procure@acme.com to confirm portal)
2) Vendor registration (Ariba/Coupa) created by Acme — Acme procurement — 2026-11-19 (dependency: completed vendor form + W-9)
3) Banking details & vendor banking verification — Redwood ops (Camila) → secure DocuSign link — 2026-11-22
4) Contract countersign & PO issuance — Acme legal/procurement — 2026-12-01
5) Final validation & go-live (test call routing) — Redwood Solutions — 2026-12-08

Responsibilities:
- Acme: submit vendor onboarding packet, create vendor in Ariba/Coupa, issue PO
- Redwood: provide vendor forms, W-9, banking info (via secure link), technical onboarding assistance
- Redwood ops (Camila) will be the point for finance/banking questions (cc'd)

Dependencies / blockers:
- Need to confirm if Acme uses Ariba or Coupa (or both) so we can join the correct portal
- Banking transfer details must be sent via secure form (we do not send bank details over plain email)

Next steps / asks for you:
1) Please confirm the procurement contact and preferred vendor portal (Ariba or Coupa) — can you loop in the person who will complete the vendor form?
2) Review the attached MAP and let me know if dates look feasible; we can tighten for a faster close if you have an earlier PO target.

I copied Camila (our finance/vendor ops lead) to handle the vendor packet and bank verification pieces.

Best,
